Method of Attack: Argument injection through associated URI protocol handlers that improperly escape their parameters
Loading a remote configuration file to automatically run arbitrary code
Command line injection via custom URI schemes (irc:, ircs:, mircurl:) allowing execution of remote scripts
Attack Vector: Clicking on malicious irc: URI links that launch mIRC with injected commands
Visiting a malicious web page containing an iframe that opens a custom irc: URL
Indicators of Compromise: Remote MIRC.ini configuration file hosted on a SAMBA server
Malicious web page with iframe triggering irc: URI
